_comment: 英文覆盖层：按索引对齐 foods/scenes/unis 的中文条目（本文件数组顺序必须与 zh 文件一致）。覆盖 desc/history 叙述字段；名称用各条目已有的 en 字段。
history: Shanghai started as a Song-era fishing village; after opening as a treaty port in 1843, the Bund grew into a 'World Architecture Expo' and the Far East's largest city. Gothic domes of the Bund face Pudong's glass towers across the river — a century of time gazing at itself. The CPC was born here; reform turned Pudong's fields into a miracle. Today Shanghai is a global financial center and the world's largest container port, where soft Wu dialects and world languages play together.
importance: International center of economy, finance, trade and shipping · National central city
foods: Nanxiang xiaolongbao — thin skin, hot soup; 'open a window, sip the soup'.
Pan-fried buns — crispy base, juicy, sesame and scallion; head of the 'four breakfast kings'.
Red-braised pork of Benbang cuisine — glossy, melt-in-mouth.
Autumn hairy crabs from Yangcheng Lake — ginger-vinegar with golden roe.
Xiaoshaoxing white-cut chicken — yellow skin, tender, just soy sauce.
Fried pork chop with soft rice cakes — sweet sauce is the finishing touch.
Crab-shell-shaped sesame pastry — salty vs sweet, an eternal debate.
Salted pork, fresh pork and spring bamboo in one pot — spring's first freshness.
Scallion oil poured over springy noodles — the taste of home.
The Park Hotel bakery queue a hundred meters long — butter puff pastry that crumbles.
scenes: The World-architecture Bund facing Lujiazui towers — a century of river views.
Ming Jiangnan garden with the zigzag bridge and teahouse.
The 468-meter TV tower — Shanghai's classic landmark.
Nanjing Road — China's first commercial street, a hundred years of bustle.
Mainland China's first Disneyland — TRON is unique here.
A 1,700-year water town with Fangsheng Bridge.
A museum of bronzes, ceramics and paintings in a tripod-shaped building.
A creative quarter in shikumen alleys.
Plane-tree avenues and the Wukang Mansion.
A migratory-bird haven at the Yangtze mouth.
